verdict.rationale: Plaid is a hosted proprietary API service. The only readable source in the pack is the public plaid-node client SDK on GitHub and a cloneable Quickstart sample app, and neither citation states an open license. The core product's source is not shown to be available. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core Plaid service, an explicit open license (e.g. MIT/Apache) on the SDKs or Quickstart, and independent confirmation of licensing terms.
